name: @free-compute/jsnode-function-movement-cloud-provider
description: Ephemeral Deno edge provider for deterministic JavaScript function movement; no customer bytes are persisted.

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: short-lived signed canonical request to the deployed Deno edge actor
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: unsigned or stale request, noncanonical JSON, oversized source, absent exact function, absent target marker, or same source and target

prepare-function-movement.returns: deterministic changed source/target bytes and SHA-256 digests
